name: mcp-server-gsc
description: Query, compare, and diagnose Google Search Console data from an MCP client

tools.name: detect_quick_wins
tools.description: Find high-ranking queries with a low CTR

tools.name: detect_traffic_drops
tools.description: Find pages that lost clicks and likely causes

tools.name: detect_content_decay
tools.description: Find pages with a sustained click decline

tools.name: find_cannibalization
tools.description: Find pages that compete for one query

tools.name: find_ctr_opportunities
tools.description: Find rows below the site's CTR benchmark

tools.name: diagnose_site
tools.description: Diagnose traffic, decay, indexing, and sitemap issues

tools.name: index_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the index status of a URL

tools.name: batch_url_inspect
tools.description: Inspect up to 100 URLs with rate limiting

credentials_file.title: Google credentials file
credentials_file.description: Service account key JSON file, or an OAuth token file saved by mcp-server-gsc auth login

allow_write.title: Allow write tools
allow_write.description: Allow tools that submit or delete sitemaps and add or remove properties
